authorization: Latest owner steering requests a bounded selector-optimization study on existing TRAIN caches. Previous completed scientific results stay closed.
boundaries: InternalTRAIN split is not fresh confirmation; originalTRAIN labels and oldprobe were previously used
No originalDEV/ordinaryDEV evaluation, backbone training, writerRL, scale, TEST, new data or automatic campaign
No inference-efficiency, improved pretrained weights, internalization or autonomous discovery claim
controls: Both gate parameterizations trained on identical FIT orders for note and no-note predictors. Global and16-position mixtures fitted only on FIT split.

evaluation.go_signal: All four criteria in all six smooth orders; this is internal development evidence requiring later fresh confirmation.
evaluation.interpretation: Compare all six paired order outcomes and common effective-stall counts. Smooth success alone does not identify the dead region as the unique cause; if hard is equally reliable, no reliability advantage is established. Internal validation is not fresh confirmation.
evaluation.secondary: Report position-control contrasts, smooth-minus-hard contrasts for both roles, every order and all absolute arms.
evaluation.stall_diagnostic: Common to both gates: >=99%calculation tokens at g<=.001 AND calculation span gain<=.01. Report exact-zero/near-zero fractions, mean weights, data gradient and update norms.
evaluation.unit: Original full16token log probability; complete sources, no filtering

gates.disabled: External disabled branch returns unchanged B0 exactly without requiring assisted predictions.
gates.qualification: Value and first derivative matched analytically at initialization. Other gate geometry differs; this does not identify a unique cause or guarantee avoidance of saturation.

inputs: Only original5120TRAIN cached causal features and target scores for B0_raw,T_note,T_raw; no new generation, model or DEV calls.
question: Does removal of the trainable hard-zero region improve reproducibility of useful selection, with the same repair applied to the no-calculation ensemble?

split.method: Stratified source-document SHA256 ordering; first512perkind internal validation,remaining2048perkind FIT
